title: Repeat-Return Fee Level on Rental Property Service Contracts
content:
**Collections rule.** The repeat-return fee level of a Rental Property Service Contracts returned-payment fee is set by the returned payments billed back on the contract in the thirty-six months before the fee is billed:

| Returned payments billed back on the contract in the 36 months before the fee is billed | Repeat-return fee level |
|---|---|
| three or more | $40.00 |
| exactly two | $35.00 |
| otherwise (fewer than two) | the tier's returned-payment fee ($25.00 on every tier) |

A returned payment counts when it was billed back within those 36 months, the one for which the fee is being billed included. The returned-payment fee is set from this fee level.

**Records read.** The returned payment charges in the contract's billing history and their dates.

## Hypothetical contracts

- Returned payments 2, 9 and 30 months before the fee is billed: three in the window, fee level $40.00.
- Returned payments 2 and 40 months before: one in the window, fee level $25.00.
- Returned payments 3 and 11 months before: two, fee level $35.00.
